Test paks copied from repak's test suite (https://github.com/trumank/repak,
MIT/Apache-2.0), encrypted with repak's published test key
`lNJbw660IOC+kU7cnVQ1oeqrXyhk4J6UAZrCBbcnp94=`.

- `enc_index.pak`: v11, encrypted index + encrypted, compressed entries
- `enc_entries.pak`: v11, plain index, encrypted entries
- `test.txt`: the original of `test.txt` inside both paks
- `test.txt`: the original of `test.txt` inside both paks
